name: service-page
title: Service Page
description: Complete service-page structures: problem, service description, process, what is included, pricing approach, FAQs, service area and CTA.
when_to_use: Businesses that sell distinct services (most local businesses).
instructions: One page per core service with a unique angle; no duplicated boilerplate across service pages.
Include the process (what happens when you call), what is included, and service-specific FAQs.
